TELEM:Aggregator.TELEM:name: cwf
TELEM:Aggregator.TELEM:description: Clearwater Forest OOBMSM Core RMID Performance Telemetry samples definition and transformation rules

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_HIT
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles when the core is stalled due to a demand load miss which hit in the LLC, across all cores running RMID 0

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_HIT_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_HIT counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_C1_RESIDENCY
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total C1 residency across all cores running RMID 0. The underlying counter increments on 100MHz clock ticks.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_C1_RESIDENCY_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_C1_RESIDENCY counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.

TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles, across all cores running RMID 0

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_MISS
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles when the core is stalled due to a demand load miss which missed all the local caches, across all cores running RMID 0. This counter also increments when the core is executing PAUSE, TPAUSE or UMWAIT instructions.

TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_MISS counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
